Malísimo momento pasamos acá con mí compañera de viaje, compramos en el shop, fuimos al sanitario y el dueño/gerente nos echó! Diciéndonos que el no tiene porqué atender al turista, q solo al cliente del ACA atiende! Nunca más .

(Translated by Google)
My travel companion and I had a terrible time here. We bought something in the shop, went to the restroom, and the owner/manager kicked us out! He told us he didn't have to serve tourists, that he only serves ACA customers! Never again.
